stories.groq_explain: It's a lightweight, single-file graph database that combines graph traversal, vector search, and full-text search in one tool. Think of it as SQLite for graph data—no server setup, just one file for your entire database. It's built for local apps that need to query relationships, semantic meaning, and text all at once, with fast performance and built-in durability. Useful for things like AI memory or local knowledge tools where you need to connect data points, search by meaning, and find text all in one place.
